claims.statement: Surface adapters normalize Slack, Linear, and GitHub events into ordered RunInput transcripts with attributed identities and structured metadata; the generic dispatcher supplies fallback identities, rejects a prebuilt input combined with raw fields, and creates a durable Protocol-v2 run.

SourceContext persists Slack, Linear, GitHub, and PR provenance in thread metadata while tolerating malformed or extended data: its models allow extras, dumps exclude unset defaults, and parse returns an empty context on validation failure.

Preparation middleware checkpoints idempotent setup by a latest-message and configuration fingerprint; it renders prompt material and separate visible participant context before execution, and combines the rendered prompt with any existing system message before each model call.

Reviewer convention context is fetched deterministically from GitHub at the PR reference, with a 64 KiB cap and AGENTS.md then CLAUDE.md fallback only on 404; changed-file ancestor instructions are fetched independently and concurrently in shallow-to-deep order.

Main-agent skills are read-only virtual files mounted by CompositeBackend, with bundled skills always available and user, organization, and desktop sources selected by run type; analyzer playbooks are seeded in input files and served from a StateBackend at /skills/.

Input messages serialize authored text in validated, escaped envelopes with namespaced sender identity, surface, kind, optional channel, and structured data; multimodal inputs envelope text blocks while retaining non-text blocks.

Dynamic-context introductions are content-hashed and deduplicated only while visible to the model; contexts behind a summarization cutoff can be reintroduced, and Slack treats unreadable state as empty so context may repeat rather than be omitted.

Main prompt construction combines source guidance, configured default instructions, repository scope, collaboration guidance, repository custom instructions, workspace instructions, and eligible recent-thread context; repository custom instructions override workspace instructions and both yield to AGENTS.md.

SubdirAgentsReadMiddleware appends unread shallow-to-deep ancestor AGENTS.md content only after a successful absolute-path read_file result, marks directly read convention files as loaded, caps candidate reads, and ignores candidate failures without failing the requested read.

Slack context construction excludes Open SWE replies and previously dispatched source timestamps, attributes third-party Slack bots as system senders, and falls back to the triggering user when the event cannot be matched to a human history message.

Linear constructs a system issue-description message followed by attributed relevant comments, preserving fetched image blocks; it selects comments from the triggering comment when identified and otherwise filters recent comments for known bot responses.
